newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway April CPI falls 0.1 pct mnth/mnth.
newsitem.headline: Norway April CPI falls 0.1 pct mnth/mnth.

text.p: Statistics Norway (SSB) issued the following economic indicator.
NORWAY CONSUMER PRICES APRIL 1997 MARCH 1997 APRIL 1996
NOTE -- Ten economists polled by Reuters forecast a year-on-year rise in April of 2.72 percent and for inflation to be unchanged month-on-month.
SSB attributed the month-on-month drop mainly to a 6.8 percent reduction in electricity prices between March and April.
The sharp fall in electricity prices was partly offset by a rise in prices of coffee, fruit and vegetables.
Prices of clothes and shoes rose 0.2 percent compared to an increase of 1.4 percent in the same period last year. This contributed to the lower overall rise year-on-year.
